# Safety paths: the machinery the routines run on. A change here is the human's to merge, however small:
# auto-merge blocks the PR and triage scores the issue risk:high. Both read this file through
# `make-routines/scripts/routines.sh safety`, so edit the list here, never in a prompt.
# One bash glob per line, matched against "/<path>": a leading / anchors at the repo root, */ matches at any
# depth, and * crosses directories. Text after the glob is a comment.
# `@tested` right after a glob marks code its tests cover: a change there is scored like any other, but only when
# `routines.sh additive` passes (it adds a new *.test.sh and touches no existing test file) and the new test fails on the base (`routines.sh redbase`, a CI check). A plain glob wins over @tested.
/.github/*          the routines, their prompts, this list, and CI
*/.flow/*           gitignored, so a PR that adds one forces it in: ready.sh runs its commands and reads its hook switches
*/.claude/*         gitignored too: forced-in skills, agents or commands load into every later run
*/CLAUDE.md
*/AGENTS.md
*/.mcp.json
*/settings*.json
*/.claude-plugin/*
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/hooks.json                  which hooks run, and on what
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/*.sh            @tested     the guards: a fix that only tightens one adds a test case
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/*.ts                        register.test.ts runs only under herdr's bun tests, which CI skips
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/*.tsx
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/notify*.sh                  notify-escape.test.sh needs osascript, so on CI it only skips
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/*.md                        a plain glob wins: prose and data in hooks/ stay the human's
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/*.json
/plugins/flow-stack/hooks/*.txt
/plugins/flow-stack/evals/*                 the harness 13 hook tests source: an edit there can switch tests off
/plugins/flow-stack/agents/*
/plugins/flow-stack/templates/*
/README.md                                  the rules the review and self-heal routines read
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/principles/*     the rules the review and self-heal routines read
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/review/*         ready.sh is the bar every push and merge clears
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/make-routines/*  this list's reader and the additive check
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/feature-map/*     feature-map/scripts/features.sh runs from ready.sh and the auto-merge re-score
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/flow/*.md        prompts have no tests, so a prompt change stays the human's
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/verify/*.md
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/seal/*.md
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/gate/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/make-gates/*
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/setup/*.md
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/flow/scripts/*   @tested
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/verify/scripts/* @tested
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/seal/scripts/*   @tested
/plugins/flow-stack/skills/setup/scripts/*  @tested     setup/scripts/inventory.sh runs at every session start
*/herdr/*                                  CI skips /herdr/, so a test there proves nothing: never @tested
